lines.en: The seabed sand is soft under my legs.
One inch a step; I am in no hurry.
Claws first, shell follows.
I shuffle slowly along the reef.
Slow walking does not mean easy catching.
My tail flicks and I back up three steps.
A thin trail of marks in the sand.
Weeds block the way; I go around.
The tide pushes; I let it push me.

lines.zh: 十只脚一起动，才这点速度。
lines.en: Ten legs move together for this much speed.
The reef crack is cool, just right.
I find my way by the sound of water.
Crawling along the reef ridge, step by step.

lines.zh: 壳又硬了一层，走起来响。
lines.en: A new hard layer. I clatter as I walk.
It's quieter under the seagrass.
A crack between seabed rocks is my home.
Long road, long life.

lines.zh: 我在沙底走，钳子随时能夹。
lines.en: I walk the sandy bottom, claws ready.
Ten legs step out; I walk sideways.
The reef is warm from the sun; just right.
This sky was always mine.
The mountain trembles beneath me.
I have circled back again.
Who walked across this seafloor?
My shell has hardened another layer.
A red shell stands out on the sand.

lines.zh: 有些同伴是蓝的，很少见。
lines.en: Some of my kin are blue, and very rare.
I grind the edge of my claw.
The stones down here are older than I am.

lines.zh: 我不追谁，谁也追不上我。
lines.en: I chase no one, and no one catches me.
My tail curls up like a fan.
Some people like to put me in a pot.

lines.zh: 这桶太小，转个身就碰壁。
lines.en: This bucket is small; one turn hits the side.
My two long antennae touch things first.
I am liveliest when the tide rises.

lines.zh: 甲壳挡住石头，挡不住饿。
lines.en: My shell stops stones, not hunger.
In the shadow of the reef no one sees me.
Slow has its perks: it saves strength.
One sitting lasts a century.
In this reef crack, I'm alone.
A little seaweed grows on my shell; I scrape it.
These claws clamp and won't let go.
The current turned — I clamp tighter.
The clouds drift so slowly.
I need a bigger cave.
Even old dragons yawn.
Half a shell is grinding in my stomach.
The tide isn't in; I'll doze a while.
These claws crack shells accurately.
A grain of sand is stuck in my claw joint.
A claw pokes out of the reef crack.
In a reef crevice, I wait for the tide.
You are standing in the water; your shoes are wet.

lines.zh: 你一站起来，整片海都黑了。
lines.en: Stand up and the whole sea goes dark.
Is that a bucket in your hand?
Do not reach into the reef crack.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我整只还大。
lines.en: Your shadow is bigger than my whole body.
I am too lazy to raise a claw, not afraid.
Crouching so long; do your legs not go numb?
I raise my claws, and not to surrender.
The water is cold; you should go ashore.
What are you laughing at? My shell looks fine.
Do not pinch me with your hand; I will pinch back.
You are blocking the light; move left.

lines.zh: 这片礁盘，没闻过你的味。
lines.en: This reef has never smelled you.
Speak. Do not just stand there.
You've stepped into my reef flat.
Interesting. You do not run.
Who let you look at me?
Hard shell, harder temper.
Halt. Do not move.
Little one, are you lost?
Another mortal hunting treasure.
The water at your feet is trembling.
The dirt in that reef crack is mine.

lines.zh: 海底的石缝里，我举着螯。
lines.en: In a rock crevice, my claws are up.
The shell cracked, and it hurts inside too.
I pull into my shell; stop knocking.
That blow loosened my claw.
I am on my back and cannot crawl.
My shell took most of it.
My shell is only a thin layer.
An antenna snapped, and my sense of direction with it.
A second stomp would crush my shell.
I retreat to the crack, very slowly.
Three of my kin have stopped moving.
The shell cracked — I can still walk sideways.
Do not make me serious.
My claws remain; my shell cracked first.
I will remember this pain.
I'll remember this blow on my shell.
Don't come closer; I pinch.
Another white mark on my shell.
How dare you!
My shell cracked; the claw still works.
My shell cracked; that really hurts.
That piece of fish, leave it right there.

lines.zh: 有鱼碎，隔着水也闻得到。
lines.en: Fish scraps; I smell them through the water.
The bait is too obvious; I am not fooled.
I shuffle over slowly so nothing is startled.
For one mouthful, it is worth it.
Put the food a little lower.
My claws open out of habit.
Keep your hand steady; my claw cannot aim.
This fish is bigger than me; never mind.
Hungry for three days, I would eat anything.
That bloody smell in the water pulls me.
That gem is mine now.
Is that gold?
The meat in that shell looks bright.
I only want to try one pinch.
I will only look, not eat.
Shiny. Let me have a look.
I should not bend down, yet...

lines.zh: 我的螯夹不开你给我的东西。
lines.en: My claws can't crack what you offer.
Sunk meat smells just right.
You kicked my shell.
I flipped over, shell down.
Sand is stirred up; I cannot see.
Do not nudge me with your toe.
My claw is stuck in a stone crack.
That was a light bump; my shell is thick.
Step back; I need to right myself.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推离了礁石。
lines.en: That pushed me away from the reef.
Your foot is harder than the reef.
Stop stepping on me; I am not a stone.
Are you well? Not that I care.
My two long antennae found you first.
You bounce off entirely.
Touch again and my claw won't be gentle.
My tail arrived first.
Hey. Find your footing.

lines.zh: 我这层壳，只护得住五点血。
lines.en: This shell guards only five points of me.
Mind your bones.
A white scratch shows on my hard shell.
Don't kick my shell with your boot.
My color is there for courting.
Blue-shelled kin are more sought after.
We do not chase; we wait to be found.
Raising claws is a greeting.
A circle in the sand settles it.
The eggs will hide beneath my tail.
Even slow creatures leave descendants.
We walk side by side, no racing.
When the tide drops, we part for our cracks.
Shell against shell is the whole ceremony.
Come live in my reef crack with me.
This shell is the brightest I've polished.
My tail is clumsy. Forgive me.
My cave is quite spacious.

lines.zh: 我的钳子举起来了，夹得住。
lines.en: My claws are up and they can pinch.
Through tides high and low, I'll wait.
The wind will witness for us.

lines.zh: 两只钳子碰一碰，就算说好了。
lines.en: Two claws touch, and that settles it.
In this life, only you.
Hold out your claw; let them touch.
This shell piece, I will keep.
My claws can only hold small things.
Sand slips out from between my claws.
This pebble is too slippery.
I pick it up and tuck it under my shell.

lines.zh: 我藏东西的地方在礁缝里。
lines.en: My hiding spot is in the reef crack.
This is too heavy; my claw aches.
Useless; I toss it back onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是吃的，是垫的。
lines.en: I am not picking food, but bedding.
Whatever falls belongs to the seabed.
Not junk. Treasure.
Who dropped it? Mine now.
Pick it up. Keep walking.

lines.zh: 我这两只螯，敲得动贝壳。
lines.en: My two claws crack shells.
Shiny. Into the cave.
I will polish it bright.
This shell is hard — can my claws crack it?
Whatever sinks, I take.
This shell goes into the crack.
Taken quietly. No one saw.
Who touched my shell?
Close enough — I pinch once.
I will not chase; I cannot catch you.
You are right beside my claw.
Consider this one a warning.

lines.zh: 我的钳口对准你的手指。
lines.en: My claw is aimed at your fingers.
Do not think slow means easy to bully.
I wait behind the reef stone.
You stepped on me; I answer back.
One pinch only, no second chase.
My armor is up; I am not rattled.
Back away; do not come so close.

lines.zh: 你在沙上踩出了两个坑。
lines.en: You left two craters in the sand.
My claw rises higher than my head.
I waited long for this.
I hear your heartbeat in the water.

lines.zh: 我的钳子已经夹住你的影子。
lines.en: My claw has already caught your shadow.
This claw of mine has chosen you.
Run, prey. Run.
One claw opens, and the seabed is mine.
From the reef crack, my claw arrives first.

lines.zh: 沙底上的脚印，我看见了。
lines.en: I see your prints on the seafloor.
You. Because you are slow.
This one fits my claw exactly.
No more hiding today; I pinch to the end.
Seabed dinner, don't run.
Meat today, and my shell is hard.
I have seen your escape route.
You take a step; I turn halfway.
I will not follow you out.
The reef crack is my border.
You go left; I turn too.
When you are far, I lower my claws.

lines.zh: 别踩水，水一动我就知道。
lines.en: Do not splash; I feel every ripple.

lines.zh: 我盯你的脚踝，那里离沙近。
lines.en: I watch your ankle; it is close to the sand.

lines.zh: 沙上你的影子移过来了。
lines.en: Your shadow slides across the sand.
Half a step closer, and I back half.

lines.zh: 我不叫，也不警告第二次。
lines.en: I do not shout, nor warn twice.
You crushed my reef stone.
So we stand off like this.
The water is cloudy; I cannot see you.
My claw stays open the whole time.

lines.zh: 你手伸到石缝口，我就等在那儿。
lines.en: Your hand reaches the crevice mouth. I wait right there.
My claws are up; keep your hands away.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里，钳子先出来。
lines.en: From a reef crack, my claws come first.
However fast you swim, you're over sand.
I walk sideways and still keep up.

lines.zh: 这一钳，值得我等这么久。
lines.en: This pinch was worth the wait.
My claw is already half raised.
My wings outrun your legs.
Hard shell, but only five drops of blood.

lines.zh: 钳子举起来，护甲顶得住。
lines.en: Claws up. My shell holds.
Your ankle is close to my claw.

lines.zh: 两只螯举着，我在礁石下。
lines.en: Both claws up, under the reef.
Closer. Just a bit closer.
You cannot escape my shadow.
I follow your footprints by scent.
Good pace. Keep going.
I clamp down and do not let go.
This pinch can crack a shell.
My claw edge has fine teeth.
You shake your hand; I swing along.
Thick shell here; try biting it.
If I catch a finger, I ease off halfway.
Two claws, one front and one back.
That one used three-tenths of my strength.
I do not tear; I only pinch.
You step back, and my claw lowers.

lines.zh: 钳子底下那截是你鞋带。
lines.en: What is under my claw is your shoelace.
My armor keeps me at the center.
I missed once, and the splash was huge.
One more pinch, then I stop.
My claw snaps; the water parts.
My shell is hard. My claws are harder.

lines.zh: 两只大螯敲起来像石头。
lines.en: My two claws knock like stones.
Good. Now it is your turn.
This is the price of defiance.
One shell shove and you back off.
Hmph. A hit.
Five drops of blood, and I still hurt you.
That one dented your armor.
Pinched you; don't say I didn't warn.
This pinch is my return gift.

lines.zh: 硬壳先撞，再看它敢不敢回手。
lines.en: My shell goes in first. Let it try to hit back.
One pinch from my claw. Do not cry out.
Good dodge. Shame.
The water is shallow here, good for settling.
We gather in groups, hidden in the sand.
The tide carried me to the reef edge.
Many kin share this sandy floor.
The red-shelled ones come out first.

lines.zh: 我找到一条礁缝，够住了。
lines.en: I found a reef crack big enough to live in.
Underwater is calmer than the shore.

lines.zh: 沙里有壳的碎片，是旧邻居。
lines.en: Shell bits in the sand are old neighbors.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像一堆石头。
lines.en: We huddle together like a pile of stones.
This rock happens to break the current.
One blue one hides among the red shells.
We move only after the waves pull back.
Long antennae in every crevice.
A new shell has not turned red yet.

lines.zh: 我卡在两块礁石中间，正好躲流。
lines.en: I wedge between two rocks where the current can't reach.

lines.zh: 壳刚换过，还是软的，我不敢走远。
lines.en: I have just molted. My shell is soft, so I stay close.
On the shallows, a few more feet appeared.
This reef flat is still mine.
First, flip a stone and find food.
A century asleep — my shell went hard.
I climbed up from the seabed.
Tide's out. I'm out foraging.
When the tide comes, I come out.
The current says there are people ashore.
This rock crevice is enough for me.
From the reef crack, my claw comes out.
Let me stretch my wings.
So much dust.
The seabed splits; I crawl out.
Something crawls beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 浅水里我回来了，别踩我。
lines.en: Back in the shallows. Don't step on me.
Who took my mountain?
The water is warm; my shell ticks.
Fire? I am the one who plays with fire.

lines.zh: 从岸上摔下来，壳磕缺了。
lines.en: Dropped from the shore, my shell chipped.
My shell hit a rock. How embarrassing.
I live in water; how do I drown?
Water... not my element.
The sand blew open and the reef shattered.
The blast shook my stance.
Something drove into the crack of my shell.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我壳上，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my shell.
No wound on my shell, yet it hurts.
Those words make my shell numb.
Too long hungry; I cannot lift my claw.
I need an ox.
The water flashed; my whole shell went numb.
Lightning and I have history.
Here there is no sand and no water at all.
Falling into the void, even claws can't grip.
